subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar e produzir, em colaboração com os colegas e com a ajuda do professor, listas, agendas, calendários, avisos, convites, receitas, instruções de montagem e legendas para álbuns, fotos ou ilustrações (digitais ou impressos), dentre outros gêneros do campo da vida cotidiana, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto/ finalidade do texto.

components.description_pt: Identificar propósito comunicativo e características estruturais de gêneros do cotidiano como listas, convites e receitas
components.description_en: Identify the communicative purpose and structural features of everyday-life genres such as lists, invitations, and recipes
components.cc_component_description: Explain how structural features of a text contribute to a reader's understanding of its content

components.description_pt: Planejar texto de gênero do cotidiano colaborativamente considerando situação comunicativa e tema
components.description_en: Plan an everyday-life genre text collaboratively, considering the communicative situation and topic
components.cc_component_description: Plan writing by considering purpose, audience, and the most significant ideas to convey

components.description_pt: Produzir texto de gênero do cotidiano escrito ou digital com apoio de colegas e professor
components.description_en: Produce a written or digital everyday-life genre text with peer and teacher support
components.cc_component_description: Collaborate with peers to produce a written report based on multiple sources

components.description_pt: Selecionar formato de gênero apropriado conforme situação e propósito comunicativo
components.description_en: Select the appropriate genre format based on the communicative situation and purpose
components.cc_component_description: Select an organizational structure appropriate to a specific writing task and purpose

cc_matches.description: Participate in shared research and writing projects (e.g., read a number of books on a single topic to produce a report; record science observations).
Describe the overall structure (e.g., chronology, comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution) of events, ideas, concepts, or information in a text or part of a text.
Develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on addressing what is most significant for a specific purpose and audience.
Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
